starter-native-coder-utility.scope: Native 604 request at PacketLog 638–639, 20 IS and a 30 s own timer. Sources 604, 613 and 1108 replace each other with max HP 500→550→600→650→500. Each source adds and removes +20 on both physical resistance stats. Technician and Master add and remove +3 and +6 Melee Defense respectively.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 604 defines 20 IS, a 30 s reuse, +50 Max Health and +20 to each physical damage resistance in the mutually exclusive Utility family.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityBuffs activates the three stat records, refreshes live max health, replaces the previous family member and withdraws its exact records when disabled.
behavior-tests.test: AbilityPassiveTests.UtilityCoderFeedsMaximumHealthAndBothPhysicalResistances and UtilityMasterReplacesTechnicianAndFeedsAllFourSelfBuffStats cover values and replacement. StarterCoderUtilityFamilyMode and native PR536 verify the actual timeline and restoration. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/536

notes.PR536: The complete first stock 604 request is 80b95c02000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000d557377c20000000086b0000000000. The 20 IS debit is visible on line 644 and the timer on 661–662. HP changes occur at 654, 729, 881 and 977. The source-specific outgoing and incoming modifiers are present at the two replacements and the final toggle. The tested patch was unchanged on rebase.
